Concat-KDF with SHA-256 (RFC 7518 §4.6.2, NIST.800-56A §5.8.1). algorithmId is the enc value (direct mode) or the alg value (key-wrapping mode); apu/apv are the decoded PartyU/VInfo.

Derive a KEK of kekLen bytes via PBES2 (RFC 7518 §4.8). hashBits selects HS256/384/512; minimum 1000 iterations enforced.
